battle.name: 文天祥反攻江西之戰
battle.brief: 景炎元年（1276）七月，丞相文天祥以同都督出江西，收兵入汀州，遣將取寧都、雩都，復贛、吉諸縣；至元十四年七月盛兵薄虔州，終為元江西宣慰使李恆所乘，潰於興國空坑。卡面希臘火即元軍攻城所用猛火油一類火器，銅管盛藥、水射油膏，專焚城樓木構；宋軍以泥塗壁、濕氈覆之、水渠逆灌以拒。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 文天祥反攻江西之戰是南宋流亡朝廷與蒙古大元在江西、閩西交界地帶的一場攻勢戰役，起於景炎元年（1276）七月，止於至元十四年（1277）秋冬。南宋一方由駐節福州、隨波逐浪的流亡朝廷益王趙昺（宋端宗）派出，文天祥以樞密使、同都督諸路軍馬的名義出巡江西，在閩西汀州設督府，遣使各處募兵籌餉；主力由他在江西起兵的舊部與閩贛兩地新集之眾組成，包括以招諭副使鄒㵯為首聚兵寧都的一支，參謀趙時賞、諮議趙孟溁率領的一支，參贊吳浚率領的一支，另有劉洙、蕭明哲、陳子敬等自江西起兵來會者；邵、永一帶的趙璠、張虎、張唐、熊桂、劉斗元、吳希奭、陳子全、王夢應，以及撫州何時等地方武裝先後響應，分寧、武寧、建昌三縣的豪傑亦遣人入軍中受約束。南宋朝廷名義上是抗元正統，實際控制只及閩北、粵東沿海數縣，兵力、糧秣、器械全靠地方拼湊。蒙古大元一方則由元廷在江西、湖廣兩處調集的兵馬擔任，江西宣慰使李恆是此役的關鍵人物，他一面遣兵援虔州（贛州），一面自將精兵直搗文天祥的興國大營；元兵另由閩北一路攻入汀州、漳州一線。江西在元人眼中是自湖廣南下閩廣的通道與糧道，在南宋眼中則是文天祥的鄉土所在、豪傑響應最盛的根據地。力量對比之下，元軍握有騎兵、攻城重械與成熟的外來火油技術，南宋只有一批各自為戰的義軍與有限的地方守軍。
countriesEn: The counterattack on Jiangxi was an offensive campaign fought by the exiled Southern Song court against the Mongol Yuan in the borderlands of Jiangxi and western Fujian, running from the seventh month of Jingyan 1 (1276) to the autumn and winter of Zhiyuan 14 (1277). The Song side was sent out by the court of the Yi King Zhao Bing (Emperor Duanzong), the rump government that had been re-established at Fuzhou and now drifted on the sea; Wen Tianxiang departed for Jiangxi with the titles of Privy Councillor and Commander-in-Chief of all the circuits' troops, opened his headquarters at Tingzhou in western Fujian, and sent envoys out to raise men and funds. His main force consisted of the troops he had originally raised in Jiangxi together with newly gathered men from both Fujian and Jiangxi: a contingent assembled at Ningdu under Zou Dao, who held the post of recruiting commissioner; a column under staff officer Zhao Shishang and counsellor Zhao Mengzhi; a column under staff officer Wu Jun; and such men as Liu Xu, Xiao Mingzhe and Chen Zijing, who had risen in Jiangxi and come to join him. Bands in the Shaoyong region under Zhao Fan, Zhang Hu, Zhang Tang, Xiong Gui, Liu Douyuan, Wu Xishi, Chen Ziquan and Wang Mengying answered the call as well, together with He Shi of Fuzhou, while the gentry of the Fenning, Wuning and Jianchang counties sent men to the camp to accept his command. Nominally the Song was the lawful anti-Yuan centre, but its effective control covered only a handful of counties on the northern Fujian and Guangdong coasts, and its soldiers, provisions and siege equipment had to be scraped together from the localities. The Yuan side was made up of troops mustered by the Yuan court in Jiangxi and in Huguang. The key figure was Li Heng, the Jiangxi xuanweishi, who sent one detachment to relieve Ganzhou (Qianzhou) while himself leading the main body straight at Wen Tianxiang's great camp at Xingguo; a further Yuan column came down the northern Fujian road and took Tingzhou and Zhangzhou. To the Yuan, Jiangxi was the corridor and the supply route by which an army advancing out of Huguang would reach Fujian and Guangdong; to the Song it was Wen Tianxiang's native soil and the ground where the gentry answered the call most readily. The balance of force was stark: the Yuan had cavalry, heavy siege engines and a mature imported technology of incendiary oil, while the Song had a patchwork of independent insurgent bands and a thin local garrison.
people: 這場戰爭的樞紐人物是文天祥（1236—1283），字履善，號文山，吉州廬陵人。寶祐四年（1256）殿試第一，歷官江西提刑、尚書左司郎官。咸淳末年元兵南下，他奉勤王詔在吉州起兵，使陳繼周發郡中豪傑、結溪峒蠻、方興召吉州兵，眾至萬人，入衛臨安。德祐二年（1276）正月除知臨安府，未幾即除樞密使，繼而除右丞相兼樞密使，赴皋亭山與元丞相伯顏抗論議和，被拘後偕左丞相吳堅、右丞相賈餘慶等北行至鎮江，夜脫入真州，苗再成出迎，獻灣頭、楊子橋、瓜步三路俱發之策。聞益王未立，他上表勸進；端宗即位後召至福州拜右丞相，旋因與左丞相陳宜中、張世傑意見不合，七月以同都督出江西，十月收兵入汀州。江西方面的主要將佐有參謀趙時賞、諮議趙孟溁、參贊吳浚、招諭副使鄒㵯、以吉諸縣兵攻泰和的黎貴達、參謀張汴，以及起兵復永豐縣的武岡教授羅開禮。元方主將李恆以江西宣慰使身份統兵，他不與宋軍糾纏攻城，而是遣一部援虔州，自將主力直趨興國。空坑潰敗之後，文天祥收殘兵奔循州駐南嶺，至元十五年（1278）十二月在五坡嶺為元帥張弘範軍所擒，押送北行，拒降三年，終於大都。
peopleEn: The pivot of this war was Wen Tianxiang (1236–1283), courtesy name Lushan, sobriquet Wenshan, a native of Luling in Jizhou. He took first place in the palace examination of 1256 and rose through the posts of Jiangxi Circuit Judge of Criminals and Left Assistant Officer of the Board of Office. When the Yuan armies moved south at the end of the Xianchun reign, he answered the call to arms in Jizhou, sending Chen Jizhou to raise the gentry of the prefecture, to ally with the tribal people of the valleys and streams, and Fang Xing to muster the Jizhou troops; ten thousand men answered, and he marched them into the capital. In the first month of Deyou 2 (1276) he was appointed prefect of Lin'an; soon after he was made Privy Councillor and then Right Chancellor and Privy Councillor, and went to Gaoting Mountain to argue terms with the Yuan chancellor Bayan. He was detained, carried north with the left chancellor Wu Jian, the right chancellor Jia Yuqing and others as far as Zhenjiang, and one night slipped away and entered Zhizhou, where Miao Zaicheng came out to meet him weeping with joy and set out a plan for a simultaneous three-pronged drive on Wantou, Yangziqiao and Guabu. Learning that the Yi King had not yet been enthroned, he petitioned for his restoration; after Duanzong took the throne he was summoned to Fuzhou and made right chancellor, but soon fell out with the left chancellor Chen Yizhong and Zhang Shijie, and in the seventh month left for Jiangxi as joint commander-in-chief, gathering his troops at Tingzhou in the tenth month. The leading Song officers in Jiangxi were the staff officer Zhao Shishang, the counsellor Zhao Mengzhi, the staff officer Wu Jun, Zou Dao the recruiting commissioner, Li Guida who led the Ji county troops against Taihe, the staff officer Zhang Bian, and Luo Kaili, the professor of Wugang, who rose to recover Yongfeng county. On the Yuan side the commander was Li Heng as Jiangxi xuanweishi, who did not entangle himself with the Song assault on the walls but sent one detachment to relieve Ganzhou and led his main body straight for Xingguo. After the rout at Kongkeng, Wen Tianxiang gathered his remnants and fled to Xunzhou, where he halted at Nanling; in the twelfth month of Zhiyuan 15 (1278) he was taken at Wupoling by the army of the marshal Zhang Hongfan, carried north, refused to surrender for three years, and died in Dadu.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是希臘火，即以銅管盛裝可燃劑、靠人力泵把油膏射出的燃燒武器。最早出現於七世紀的拜占庭帝國，用於海軍與攻城部隊，配方屬帝國最高機密，配方隨沉船一同失傳，此後歐亞各地通行的「希臘火」「猛火油」多只是近似配方的仿製品。蒙古人在十三世紀西征與攻宋戰役中，先後從西亞、中亞的伊斯蘭世界與漢地工程技術裡吸收了這類火油攻城法，鑄成銅管或銅釜的噴射器具，架在木製或鐵製的器械上，攻城時對木構城樓、塔棚、浮橋、攻城塔與艦船射油點火，燒毀城防骨架與糧秣堆場，也用來在守軍反擊時封住突破口。同一套元軍攻城體系在南宋其他戰役有詳細記錄，如襄陽、潭州之役中元軍以猛火油焚燒宋軍城樓與木構攻具，宋軍的應對是以泥塗抹城壁與木構、預掘水溝儲水、覆以濕氈與濕麻布，或在城下放水以淹滅火油；本役中元軍攻虔州（贛州）、興國等處同樣倚仗這類火油與投射器械，因江西各城城郭多以木構樓櫓為主，正是火油最有效的目標。宋軍方面則是宋制式的環首刀、長柄矛、弓弩（以檣弩、矢為主力）、札甲與皮甲、木盾與泥牌；攻虔州時曾以火矢焚燒城樓附屬建築，圍城器械靠臨時砍伐的木材與繩索拼湊，糧秣從閩北汀州、漳州、泉州一線與贛南稻米產區分批運入，馬匹缺乏，難以與元軍騎兵在曠野抗衡。真正決定勝負的，還是攻城器械的總量與投放速度，而非單件奇兵。須說明的是，卡面那件拜占庭銅管原件並未出現在江西的戰場上，留在場上的只是它的後裔——元軍攻城所施的猛火油與銅管投射器。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is Greek fire: a burning agent carried in a copper tube and shot out as a spray of oil by a hand pump. It first appeared in the seventh century in the Byzantine Empire, used by the navy and by siege troops, and the formula was the empire's highest secret, so closely guarded that the formula went down with the ship and was lost; the Greek fire and the naphtha oil that circulated across Eurasia afterwards were for the most part only imitations of that formula. During the thirteenth century, in their westward campaigns and their wars against the Song, the Mongols absorbed this technique of fire-oil siegecraft from the Islamic world of West and Central Asia and from the engineering arts of the Chinese, casting the projector as a copper tube or copper cauldron and mounting it on wooden or iron frames. On campaign they squirted burning oil and lit it against timber galleries, towers, floating bridges, siege towers and ships, burning away the wooden frame of the defences and the stacks of provisions, and using it to seal a breach when the garrison counter-attacked. The same Yuan siege system is recorded in detail in other Song campaigns: in the sieges of Xiangyang and Tanzhou the Yuan used naphtha oil against Song gate towers and wooden siege works, and the Song answered by plastering walls and timber with mud, digging water ditches in advance, covering the works with wet felt and wet hemp cloth, or letting water out at the foot of the wall to drown the burning oil. In this campaign the Yuan relied on the same sort of oil and projectors when they attacked Ganzhou (Qianzhou) and Xingguo, because the towns of Jiangxi were largely built of timber galleries and barbicans, the most vulnerable of targets for burning oil. On the Song side were the standard Song panhead sabres, long-shafted spears, bows and crossbows (the principal missile weapons being the heavy crossbow and the bolt), lacquered and leather armour, wooden shields and mud-plastered boards; when assaulting Ganzhou they fired incendiary arrows at the timber outworks of the walls, and the siege equipment had to be patched together from timber cut on the spot and from rope, while provisions came in batches from Tingzhou, Zhangzhou and Quanzhou in northern Fujian and from the rice lands south of Ganzhou. Horses were scarce, and the Song could not contest the Yuan cavalry in the open field. What really decided the issue was the total weight of siege equipment and the speed with which it could be brought up, not any single exotic weapon. It should be said plainly that the Byzantine copper tube on the card never appeared on a Jiangxi battlefield; what was there was only its descendant, the burning oil and the copper-tube projectors used by the Yuan at the walls.
tactics: 南軍的戰法是以分散起兵、逐縣收復的連鎖攻勢配合正面攻堅。景炎元年出師後先取閩贛邊界的寧都、雩都，作為前進基地；其後主力北上會昌、興國，以趙時賞、趙孟溁、張汴等部盛兵薄贛城，強攻虔州；同時以鄒㵯率贛諸縣兵搗永豐、黎貴達率吉諸縣兵攻泰和為兩翼策應，迫使守軍分兵。政治上的爭取與戰術攻擊並行：贛、吉諸縣多數復歸，臨洪諸郡亦紛紛送款，邵、永及撫州諸縣義軍先後響應，形成網狀的鄉村控制，試圖以時間換取對贛南的整合。但各部互不統屬，糧秣靠就地徵集，圍城日久便告斷糧。元軍的戰法是典型的蒙古式機動加漢式攻城：以騎兵巡哨、分割敵軍、斷絕糧道，對零星起兵逐一殲滅，寧都攻鄒㵯、永豐破羅開禮部皆出於此；同時不急於強攻虔州城牆，先遣一部援城牽制宋軍攻勢，再由李恆親率主力避開宋軍鋒頭直插其背後大營。空坑之戰中元軍追擊沿山嶺隘道窮追不捨，把宋軍壓進狹窄谷地，使其無從展開。攻城與火攻配合使用，木構城防為猛火油的首要目標，守軍則以泥塗、濕氈、水溝等手段抵抗火油與火矢。
tacticsEn: The Song method was a chain of separate uprisings, each recovering a county in turn, combined with frontal assault. After setting out in Jingyan 1 the army first took Ningdu and Yudu on the Fujian-Jiangxi border as forward bases; the main body then pushed north through Huichang to Xingguo, where the columns of Zhao Shishang, Zhao Mengzhi and Zhang Bian pressed hard against the walls of Ganzhou; at the same time Zou Dao was sent with the troops of the Ganzhou counties to strike at Yongfeng and Li Guida with the troops of the Ji counties against Taihe, as a two-wing pincer intended to force the defenders to split. Political work ran alongside the assault: most counties of the Ganzhou and Ji circuits came back to the Song, the prefectures of Linchuan and Hongdu sent in their submission, and bands in the Shaoyong and Fuzhou areas answered in turn, creating a net of village-level control in the hope of trading time for the integration of southern Ganzhou. But the columns did not obey one command, provisions were gathered on the spot, and once the siege dragged on the army went short of food. The Yuan method was the classic combination of Mongol mobility and Chinese siegecraft: cavalry patrolled, cut the enemy into separate groups and severed his supply lines, picking off the isolated risings one by one, as at Ningdu against Zou Dao and at Yongfeng against Luo Kaili's men. They did not press hard against the walls of Ganzhou at once; a detachment was first sent to relieve the city and hold the Song assault in check, and then Li Heng led the main body, slipping past the Song spearhead, straight at the great camp behind it. In the fighting at Kongkeng the Yuan pursued without halting along the defiles of the hills, squeezing the Song army into narrow ground where it could not deploy. Besiege and fire attack were used together, the timber frame of the defences being the first target of the burning oil, while the defenders met oil and incendiary arrows with plastered mud, wet felt and water ditches.
data: 時間線最為清楚：景炎元年（1276）七月文天祥以同都督出江西，同年十月收兵入汀州；至元十四年（1277）正月元兵入汀州，文天祥移軍漳州；四月入梅州，五月出江西入會昌，六月入興國縣，七月盛兵薄虔州城；其後興國大營失守，兵潰於空坑。空間上，軍隊自閩西汀州、漳州一線北進，經會昌、興國至虔州，路線沿贛江上游谷地迂迴，單程約數百里，山嶺與河谷交替，縱深補給困難。戰果方面，文天祥一度收復贛州十縣、吉州四縣，與《宋史》本傳「吉八縣復其半」的記載相合，臨洪諸郡送款；寧都之役中起事者劉欽、鞠華叔、顏斯立、顏起巖四人皆死，復永豐縣的羅開禮兵敗被執、死於獄。代價方面，吳浚降而為文天祥縊殺，黎貴達潛謀降被執殺，部將鞏信在方石嶺拒戰中箭而死；趙時賞於一年後被元軍擒獲，鄒㵯自頸而死。兵員規模的可靠數字只到「有眾萬人」一級，其後各部義軍人數與元軍出動兵力，史料均無確數，本傳亦不載圍虔州所部之眾與攻城器械數量。
dataEn: The chronology is the clearest part of the record. In the seventh month of Jingyan 1 (1276) Wen Tianxiang left for Jiangxi as joint commander-in-chief, and in the tenth month of the same year he gathered his troops into Tingzhou; in the first month of Zhiyuan 14 (1277) the Yuan took Tingzhou and Wen Tianxiang moved his army to Zhangzhou; in the fourth month he entered Meizhou, in the fifth he came out into Jiangxi and reached Huichang, in the sixth he entered Xingguo county, and in the seventh he pressed hard against the walls of Ganzhou; afterwards his great camp at Xingguo was lost and the army scattered at Kongkeng. Spatially the force moved north from the Tingzhou-Zhangzhou line in western Fujian, through Huichang and Xingguo to Ganzhou, the road winding along the upper valley of the Gan River for several hundred li, hills and river valleys alternating, which made the supply line in depth extremely hard to keep. As for results, Wen Tianxiang at one point recovered ten counties of the Ganzhou circuit and four of the Ji circuit, which agrees with the biography in the Song History that of the eight counties of Ji, half were recovered, while the prefectures of Linchuan and Hongdu sent in their submission. In the fighting at Ningdu the risers Liu Qin, Ju Huashu, Yan Sili and Yan Qiyan all died, and Luo Kaili, who had risen to recover Yongfeng county, was taken after his defeat and died in prison. On the other side of the ledger, Wu Jun surrendered and was hanged by Wen Tianxiang, Li Guida who plotted to surrender was caught and killed, the officer Gong Xin was killed by an arrow while fighting at Fangshi Ridge, Zhao Shishang was taken by the Yuan a year later, and Zou Dao cut his own throat. The only reliable figure for the size of the forces is the ten thousand men of the original rising; the numbers of the later insurgent bands and of the Yuan columns are not recorded, and the biography does not state how many men besieged Ganzhou nor how many siege engines they used.
cause: 起因有三層。第一層是國難：德祐二年（1276）正月元軍入臨安，謝氏太皇太后奉傳國璽與降表，恭帝被押往大都，益王趙昺在福州即位，是為端宗，朝廷遷作海上行朝，仍以收復中原為號召。文天祥此前已任右丞相兼樞密使，赴皋亭山議和被拘留，脫身後輾轉閩中，在福州拜右丞相，與陳宜中、張世傑議不合而自請督兵江西。第二層是地緣：江西為元軍自湖廣、襄陽方向南下閩廣的通道與糧道，元人必須平定贛南才能把兩廣與福建納入版圖；同時江西是文天祥家鄉與舊部、豪傑密集之區，他在此號召最易集響應。文天祥在出師前所上的分鎮策——以廣西益湖南建閫長沙、廣東益江西建閫隆興、福建益江東建閫番陽、淮西益淮東建閫揚州——未被朝廷採行，說明中樞既無兵可調，也無財可給，於是這場反攻完全依賴地方義軍與臨時募集。第三層是人事：文天祥在閩以同都督開府南劍州，募兵籌餉皆親自為之，既無朝廷的正式授權，也無可倚仗的統一軍令，這使他的江西之舉從一開始就是一次以個人信望與地緣人脈換取戰果的冒險。
causeEn: The causes run in three layers. The first is the national catastrophe: in the first month of Deyou 2 (1276) the Yuan army entered Lin'an, the dowager empress Xie presented the imperial seal and a surrender, the child emperor was carried off to Dadu, and the Yi King Zhao Bing was enthroned at Fuzhou as Duanzong; the court became a government adrift on the sea yet still called for the recovery of the central plains. Wen Tianxiang had already been made right chancellor and privy councillor, had been held after going to Gaoting Mountain to negotiate, and after escaping had wandered through central Fujian; at Fuzhou he was once more made right chancellor, and because he disagreed with Chen Yizhong and Zhang Shijie he asked to take command in Jiangxi. The second layer is geography: Jiangxi was the corridor and supply route by which the Yuan could advance from Huguang and Xiangyang into Fujian and Guangdong, and the Yuan had to pacify southern Ganzhou before the two Guang and Fujian could be brought into their orbit; at the same time Jiangxi was Wen Tianxiang's home country, dense with his old followers and local gentry, and therefore the place where his call would be answered most readily. The scheme Wen Tianxiang submitted before setting out, to establish four regional commands by pairing Guangxi with Hunan at Changsha, Guangdong with Jiangxi at Longxing, Fujian with Jiangdong at Panyang and Huaxi with Huaidong at Yangzhou, was not adopted by the court, which shows that the centre had neither troops to move nor money to give; the counterattack therefore rested entirely on local insurgents and on fresh recruitment. The third layer is personal: Wen Tianxiang opened his headquarters at Nanjian in Fujian as joint commander-in-chief and raised men and money himself, having neither the formal authority of the court nor a unified order to lean on, which made his Jiangxi venture from the outset an attempt to buy results with personal prestige and regional connections.
impact: 反攻江西的軍事成果最終歸零，但它在元宋最後兩年裡的作用並非全然不可見。第一，它拖住了元軍南下的節奏。虔州城未被元軍迅速攻下，江西腹地的義軍網又迫使元軍不能只取交通線而不管鄉鎮，元廷必須投入更多兵馬與時間肅清贛南、閩北，福建與廣東的抵抗因此得以延續數月。第二，它暴露了南宋末年軍制的根本病灶：數萬義軍無統一編制、無穩定糧秣、無重械，一旦指揮中樞與主營同時受敵於奇襲，全軍即潰，寧都、興國兩次崩潰皆出於此。第三，它把文天祥推向更深的絕境，也把他推成最具象徵性的抗元人物：江西敗後他收殘兵奔循州、駐南嶺，轉戰閩粵，屢起屢挫，至元十五年（1278）十二月五坡嶺被擒，押送北行途中八日不食而不死，在大都拒降三年，最終慷慨就義；其《正氣歌》與《過零丁洋》成為漢地士人抵抗記憶的文本。從長時段看，江西失守也意味著宋廷完全放棄陸路，僅餘海上行朝，最終崖山一敗，陸宋終結。
impactEn: The military results of the Jiangxi counterattack came to nothing in the end, yet its bearing on the last two years of the Yuan-Song war was not entirely invisible. First, it held up the pace of the Yuan advance south. Ganzhou was not taken quickly, and the web of insurgent bands in the Jiangxi interior forced the Yuan to take more than the lines of communication, so that the Yuan court had to commit further men and more time to clear southern Ganzhou and northern Fujian; the resistance in Fujian and Guangdong was thereby prolonged by several months. Second, the campaign exposed the deep sickness of the Song military system at the end: tens of thousands of insurgents with no unified organisation, no stable provisions and no heavy equipment, and when the command centre and the great camp were both hit at once the whole army dissolved, as at Ningdu and at Xingguo. Third, the defeat drove Wen Tianxiang deeper into extremity and simultaneously made him the most emblematic of the anti-Yuan figures: after Jiangxi he gathered his remnants, fled to Xunzhou and halted at Nanling, fought on in Fujian and Guangdong, and after repeated defeats was taken at Wupoling in the twelfth month of Zhiyuan 15 (1278); on the way north he ate nothing for eight days without dying, refused to surrender for three years in Dadu, and died heroically. His Song of Righteous Spirit and his poem on crossing Lingding Isle became the text in which the literati of the Central Plain kept their memory of resistance. In the longer run, the loss of Jiangxi also meant that the Song court had abandoned the land entirely, keeping only the floating court at sea, and after the defeat at Yashan the land-based Song came to an end.
result: 至元十四年（1277）秋，虔州城仍未下，但元江西宣慰使李恆自將主力避開宋軍攻城部隊，兵出興國，文天祥措手不及，率軍退會合鄒㵯於永豐，㵯部先潰，元軍窮追至方石嶺，部將鞏信拒戰中箭而死，至空坑全軍崩散，家眷隨軍陷於敵手，參謀趙時賞以肩輿應聲稱「我姓文」代主軍被擒，文天祥因此得脫，收殘兵奔循州、駐南嶺，殺潛降的黎貴達以肅軍紀。江西方面，鄒㵯部寧都先敗、羅開禮部永豐覆沒、吳浚以雩都降而遭縊殺，贛、吉、撫、臨洪諸縣的起義隨主力崩潰而散，江西重歸元廷控制。戰事於是從反攻江西轉為文天祥率殘部的流竄：景炎二年起他轉戰閩粵沿海，景炎三年十二月在潮陽五坡嶺為元帥張弘範軍所擒，送大都囚禁三年不降；至元十六年（1279）二月崖山宋軍覆亡，趙昺投海，陸宋至此終結，張世傑死於焦山，陸秀夫負帝投海。文天祥於大德元年（1283）在大都就義，事後追封信國公。
resultEn: In the autumn of Zhiyuan 14 (1277) the walls of Ganzhou still stood, but Li Heng, the Yuan xuanweishi of Jiangxi, led his main body clear of the Song assault force and struck out from Xingguo. Wen Tianxiang was caught unprepared, fell back to join Zou Dao at Yongfeng, where Zou's troops broke first; the Yuan pursued them to Fangshi Ridge, where the officer Gong Xin was killed by an arrow while holding the line, and at Kongkeng the whole army scattered, the commander's family falling into the enemy's hands with the camp. The staff officer Zhao Shishang, carried in a shoulder sedan, was asked who he was and answered that his surname was Wen, so the Yuan took him for the commander and carried him off; Wen Tianxiang escaped thanks to this. He gathered his remnants, fled to Xunzhou and halted at Nanling, and executed Li Guida for plotting to surrender in order to tighten discipline. In Jiangxi itself, Zou Dao's men were beaten at Ningdu, Luo Kaili's men were destroyed at Yongfeng, and Wu Jun, who surrendered at Yudu, was hanged; the risings in the Ganzhou, Ji, Fuzhou and Linchuang counties fell apart with the main army, and Jiangxi returned to Yuan control. The war therefore turned from a counterattack on Jiangxi into a running fight by Wen Tianxiang and his remnants: from Jingyan 2 he campaigned along the Fujian and Guangdong coasts, and in the twelfth month of Jingyan 3 he was taken at Wupoling near Chaoyang by the army of the marshal Zhang Hongfan and was thrown into a prison in Dadu, where he refused to surrender for three years. In the second month of Zhiyuan 16 (1279) the Song fleet was destroyed at Yashan, Zhao Bing threw himself into the sea, and the land-based Song came to an end; Zhang Shijie died at Jiaoshan and Lu Xiufu bore the emperor with him into the sea. Wen Tianxiang was executed at Dadu in Dade 1 (1283) and was afterwards posthumously granted the title of Duke of Xinguo.
